title: Summit Seeker
description:
You are given an integer array arr of length n that represents a mountain array.

An array is considered a mountain array if:

There exists an index i such that:
arr[0] < arr[1] < ... < arr[i] (strictly increasing), and
arr[i] > arr[i+1] > ... > arr[n-1] (strictly decreasing)

The element at index i is called the peak element.

Task

Return the index of the peak element.

Your solution must run in O(log n) time.

Example 1

Input:
arr = [0,1,0]

Output:
1

Example 2

Input:
arr = [0,2,1,0]

Output:
1

Example 3

Input:
arr = [0,10,5,2]

Output:
1

Constraints
3 ≤ arr.length ≤ 100000
0 ≤ arr[i] ≤ 1000000
arr is guaranteed to be a valid mountain array
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
